profile.headline: IT Service Desk Analyst II at Navicent Health
profile.summary:
A college graduate seeking a software engineering position that will allow me to utilize my skills in:

•Web development using HTML, Tailwind CSS, JS and AlpineJS 

•Providing excellent IT support/customer service by clearly communicating IT needs and solutions to end users. 

•Installing and repairing computer supported hardware.

•Working as a part of a team.

•Identifying and resolving basic network issues.

•Multitasking skills.  

•Assisting in troubleshooting and resolving desktop/laptop issues.

•Maintaining an accurate documentation of hardware and software inventory.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed front-end web applications using JavaScript,  Microsoft VS Code, HTML, Alpine.js & CSS.
positions.insights: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), Tailwind CSS and +6 skills

positions.title: IT Service Desk Analyst II
positions.description:
•Provides over the phone technical assistance to medical staff and non-employees with tier 1 issues concerning electronic health record software and various PC software issues.

•Works with Active Directory management software such as Hyena to assist staff with verifying users’ identities and maintaining access to their accounts.

•Uses ticketing software such as Footprints and ServiceNow to clearly document troubleshooting steps to resolve various software issues.

positions.title: Customer Care Associate
positions.description:
•Provided over the phone troubleshooting technical assistance to Apple’s mobile device users and MacOS users.

•Mentored new employees on iOS software issues.

•Used ticketing software to clearly document issues customers had encountered using iOS mobile and MacOS devices along with troubleshooting steps used to resolve customer’s issues for tier 2 agents and Apple store associates to review.

positions.title: IT Contractor
positions.description:
•Worked with teams responsible for the reinstallation of PCs for assigned schools within the Bibb County Public School District.

•Performed onsite imaging for new laptops and desktops.

•Configured user accounts by using batch files, added accounts to the Windows 7 Domain and installed antivirus software.

volunteerExperiences.description: Provided assistance with stocking and inventory maintenance as well as processing of clothing donations.

skills.name: Providing on-site computer hardware and software support.
Identifying and resolving basic network issues.
Providing server and network administration support .
Maintaining an accurate documentation of hardware and software inventory.
HTML, DHTML, XHTML, HTML5, PHP, JavaScript, JQuery, CSS, CSS3.
Apache Web Server, Router Set-up and Configuration, TCP/IP, WAN, LAN, Routing
Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint), Adobe Dreamweaver, Adobe Photo
